name: Fleet Spec Sheet

paper.role: primary text on ground; spec plates

azure.role: Microsoft Azure blue: healthy / updated / completed stage, hull, CTA plate

azureLight.role: wave line, lit-dot glow, readable blue text

fleet.role: Fleet Manager purple: hub, membership, placement fills, halos

fleetLight.role: purple text on ground, container fill

sources.moodboard: ground/dotOff from seed 01 (#232A28/#394239, hue-shifted to blue-grey); paper = overview #EEECE2; drift = overview #F5600A; mute from overview greys

rules: ground + dot field in every frame
max 3 state colours (azure, fleet family, drift) on screen at once
drift appears only before the fleet is managed (S01-S03) and on pending update stages (S05); never after 36 s
fleet purple = Fleet Manager acting; azure = the result being healthy/updated
contrastRules: readable text on ground: paper, mute (>= 20 px), azureLight, fleetLight, fleetPale, drift (>= 24 px)
azure text only >= 48 px bold; fleet (#773ADC) never as text
text on azure/fleet plates is paper (azure plate 3.8:1 -> >= 32 px bold only; fleet plate 5.2:1 -> >= 24 px)
